name.description: The bundle's name: lowercase words joined by '-' (e.g. rail-watch), at most 40 characters, not an existing bundle.

kind.description: data: seeds only (workflows, agents, views) using the brain's tools. rust: also a crate with tools.

description.description: What it does, one line, at most 300 characters, no double quotes and no '{', '}' or '%'.

tools.description: rust only: the tools it will offer, snake_case, none the brain already has.

graph_labels.description: rust only: the graph labels it owns, PascalCase; each gets an id constraint.

needs_env.description: The env vars it needs to load (an API key), UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.

why.description: Why the brain needs this plugin, and the proposal or todo it serves: the first thing the owner reads.
